up: Retrieve compound records (compound_key, compound_name, molregno, record_id, doc_id, compound_key) for the document with chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728495'. Return all matching compounds without further filtering; do not apply additional filters such as doc_type, DOI, year, or target-related criteria.
sql:
SELECT c.compound_key, c.compound_name, a.molregno, a.record_id, a.doc_id, a.compound_key
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records a ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728495'
